title: GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM)
description:
About the Job:
AI-powered workflows are only as good as the customer data underneath them. LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As our GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM), you will set the rules that make our core customer data (accounts, contacts, subscriptions, and users) accurate, consistent, and trusted across Salesforce, our billing and finance systems, marketing automation, product usage data, and the data warehouse.
This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of the data model and its standards. You will partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, Finance Systems, Legal, and Security to put those standards into production. Your work is the foundation for reliable reporting, accurate territory and segmentation, clean pipeline attribution, and the AI workflows that depend on high-quality data.
Responsibilities:

• Own the MDM roadmap and operating model for the account, contact, and organization hierarchy domains.

• Define golden record rules: matching, merging, survivorship, and parent/child hierarchies across CRM, billing, product, and support systems.

• Set data governance standards, including ownership, stewardship roles, definitions, and quality SLAs, in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success. Run the processes for onboarding new data sources, handling change requests, and managing lifecycle events such as mergers, acquisitions, and customer reorganizations.

• Design and monitor data quality rules, scorecards, and dashboards covering completeness, accuracy, duplication, and timeliness. Drive remediation and report data health, risks, and progress to leadership with clear metrics and business impact.

• Specify integration patterns and acceptance criteria across Salesforce, the data warehouse, and enrichment providers, and work with Data Engineering and GTM Systems to build them. Recommend build vs. buy for MDM, identity resolution, enrichment, and data quality tooling.

• Provide trusted, well-documented data products for analytics and AI use cases. Act as the data owner with Legal and Security on PII handling, GDPR and CCPA requirements, retention, and access controls.

•
Who You'll Work With: Data Engineering and GTM Systems build pipelines and Salesforce configuration. Legal and Security own privacy and security decisions, and you inform them as the data owner. You own the rules, standards, and acceptance criteria that tell everyone else what "correct" looks like.

Qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience in data management, data governance, data engineering, or analytics, including 2+ years leading MDM or data quality programs.

• Hands-on experience designing match, merge, and survivorship rules and golden record or hierarchy models, with results you can describe.

• Experience with Salesforce data models and CRM data quality at scale.

• Experience building and operating a data governance framework: policies, stewardship models, and SLAs.

• Ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

• A track record of delivering cross-functional programs without direct authority.

•
Nice to Have

• Experience at a B2B SaaS company with a product-led or hybrid sales motion, including mapping product users and workspaces to CRM accounts.

• Familiarity with enrichment and firmographic data, entity matching approaches, and ML-assisted or LLM-assisted matching and cleansing.

• Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and security frameworks such as SOC 2.

What You'll Do
The Senior Tax Analyst is a key contributor to Avalara ’s Premium Managed Returns Service (PRS) offering, where you will provide a high level of service to customers enrolled in the Premium Managed Returns Service. You will be responsible for identifying areas of improvement as well as serving an elite group of customers with highly complex returns as their primary point of contact. The ideal candidate is highly driven, detail oriented and proficient at balancing multiple priorities. This position directly protects client revenue, mitigates tax exposure, and advances Avalara ’s AI-first operational strategy by embedding automation and AI into daily compliance work.
How This Role Elevates Avalara

• Protects customer revenue through accurate, on-time state and local sales and use tax compliance support.

• Reduces compliance risk by applying deep jurisdictional expertise and robust variance, exception, and notice management.

• Increases operational scale by designing and refining Premium Managed Returns Service workflows, data ingestion patterns, and automation that reduce manual effort.

• Enhances customer trust as a knowledgeable, proactive, senior point of contact for complex portfolios on the PRS product.

• Raises team capability by mentoring junior analysts and sharing documentation, process improvements, and AI best practices.

Compliance and Filing Operations

• Manage a select portfolio of customer accounts as their dedicated primary point of contact for all returns-related questions and escalations

• Research and resolve jurisdictional tax notices on behalf of customers with clear, timely, and well-documented communication

• Perform quality assurance reviews related to sales and use tax content and jurisdiction form changes

Customer and Relationship Management

• Serve as the first point of contact for customers’ sales and use tax returns questions, setting clear expectations and relaying complex compliance information in an accessible, actionable manner

• Own the onboarding and validation of new sales and use tax returns customers, ensuring a smooth transition into Avalara ’s platform

• Communicate regularly and effectively with customers, jurisdictions, and internal teams as part of research and resolution workflows

• Take full ownership of customer satisfaction, demonstrating empathy and proactive responsiveness to customer needs

Process Improvement and Team Enablement

• Identify, develop, and implement automation improvements to serve customers across a variety of market and tax verticals

• Identify process and technology gaps and recommend improvements that reduce risk, increase throughput, and improve customer outcomes

• Assist with implementation, training, and documentation initiatives in support of the broader team

• Coordinate and lead training for junior-level employees, serving as a knowledge resource for critical troubleshooting and in-cycle risk reduction

• Apply expert knowledge of jurisdiction websites and taxpayer-facing portals, including data input nuances and system limitations

AI Bar Raiser Expectation
This role is an opportunity to be at the leading edge of Avalara ’s AI-first mission within one of our most complex and high-stakes compliance operations. We are looking for someone who goes beyond using AI - someone who brings deeper AI expertise than the current team and actively raises the capability of the people around them. The successful candidate will be a genuine AI Bar Raiser: a practitioner who can demonstrate, teach, and institutionalize AI-enabled ways of working that make the entire PRS team faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

Built for Asia. Delivered as infrastructure. Operated as a partner.

As Business Analyst, APAC Jurisdictions, you will be the data and requirements analyst behind AsiaVerify ’s jurisdiction coverage. You will work out, on evidence, where we should deepen our existing coverage and where we should expand next, and then turn those decisions into requirements, data mappings and acceptance criteria our Engineering team can build against.
Your time will be split broadly equally between strengthening coverage in the markets we already serve and assessing new markets across the Asia-Pacific region. For each jurisdiction, you will look at registry access, data quality, regulation, data partner options and commercial demand, and present a clear recommendation.

• New Market Expansion
Assess new APAC markets, both those requested by clients and those identified through a structured review of the region, and recommend which to pursue and in what order.

• Registry and Data Source Analysis
Identify and evaluate official company registries and other data sources in each market: access model, entity coverage, available fields, ownership and officer data, update frequency, language, reliability and cost.
